facets.description: client.go Authenticate: TagDevice now runs synchronously, so every anonymous auth blocks on COUNT+UPDATE/INSERT DB latency (no longer best-effort async)
TagDevice now uses the request context instead of a detached background context with timeout, so request cancellation aborts device tagging
ErrDeviceLimitReached now fails anonymous Authenticate, but callers (authn service/HTTP handlers) were not updated to handle the new refusal case
